topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Hey there! I'm so glad you asked about using a corner of the yard for a garden. I love the idea of fresh veggies and flowers right outside! What are you thinking of growing? Herbs? Maybe tomatoes? I can’t wait to see where this goes. Plus, I’ve been looking for a new hobby, and maybe I’ll catch the gardening bug from you. Let’s pick a spot that gets plenty of sun and figure out the logistics. This is going to be so much fun!
